failure_diagnosis.repair_hint: The TCP moved substantially but the manipulated object did not. Do not add more steps or repeat the same waypoint. Change the contact side or height, verify object motion after a short action pulse, and use a grasp-and-place strategy when the observed target gripper supports it.
